claim.summary: Surface operation aliases mount atomically, invoke through exact Catalog contracts, obey bounded reject/replace/queue semantics, publish contained terminal lifecycles, and defer queue promotion until an opaque settlement lease is acknowledged.

semantics.mountPublication: atomic frozen idle generation without host calls
semantics.aliasAuthority: predeclared surface-local alias fixed to one exact operation capability for its lifetime; the required invocation assertion verifies but never selects that authority
semantics.contractAuthority: factory-authenticated M02-T11 Catalog set supplies input/output schemas, public errors, and effect
semantics.operationSnapshotAuthority: exact current manager-issued object identity; stale, foreign, and ABA-equal views rejected
semantics.inputBoundary: already resolved inert object is detached and validated against exact operation-input schema before acceptance
semantics.actionMaterialization: ValueSpec, token, and format composition is deliberately deferred to M04-T11
semantics.acceptedIdentity: operation: + RFC 8785 canonical [alias, zeroBasedAttemptGeneration]; invalid and rejected attempts consume no generation
semantics.capabilityAssertion: missing assertion is malformed and mismatch is controlled before input validation, identity allocation, lifecycle publication, or host effects
semantics.reject: pending alias refuses a new invocation without host effects
semantics.replace: replacement validates first, then supersedes active and queued alias work without settlement leases
semantics.queue: accepted FIFO identity is retained immediately; a settlement-handler turn may stage the FIFO head as pending, but no staged host call starts before predecessor lease acknowledgement
semantics.outputBoundary: exact operation-output validation before detached frozen successful lifecycle exposure
semantics.technicalFailure: denial, invalid output, malformed/undeclared/throw/reject adapter outcomes return lifecycle to idle with redacted diagnostics
semantics.staleSettlement: attempt authority rejected before settlement envelope inspection
semantics.settlementLease: opaque manager-bound one-shot acknowledgement; terminal lifecycle is public before delivery
semantics.turnBoundary: M04-T11/M04-T13 settlement action turn must finish before acknowledgement promotes queued work

finiteLimits.hostProfile: may lower but never raise finite ceilings
finiteLimits.snapshotCapacity: pending and terminal transitions reserved before every started or queued acceptance
finiteLimits.queueScope: aggregate manager bound, not multiplied by alias count

semantics.hostCallbacks: operation and diagnostic callbacks invoked without a receiver
semantics.disposal: terminal, idempotent, resolves unfinished work, invalidates leases, and replaces handle authority with sentinel

focusedTestTitles: mounts the whole alias inventory atomically as one frozen idle generation without host calls
rejects the entire mount for an unknown capability or malformed alias without partial authority
requires a factory-authenticated Catalog and a closed accessor-free mount envelope
accepts frozen-schema document identifiers and only downward, exact integer limits
captures host callbacks at mount instead of observing later caller mutation
enters pending synchronously and sends detached Catalog-owned effect/input/context
validates resolved input against the exact Catalog and invalid attempts consume no identity
rejects unknown aliases and capability assertion mismatches without consuming identity
rejects a live JS request missing its required operation assertion without consuming identity
requires the exact current manager snapshot and rejects stale, foreign, and ABA-equal copies
defaults omitted concurrency to reject and rejected attempts consume no generation
keeps synchronous host results asynchronous so pending is observable first
invokes operation and diagnostic callbacks receiver-independently
guards early diagnostic reporting against recursive runtime reentry
serializes queue mode and requires terminal lease acknowledgement before promotion
stages a settlement-handler invocation as pending but gates its host call until acknowledgement
lets ack-gated replace supersede the complete FIFO backlog before launching newest work
stages the existing FIFO head when a settlement handler appends more queue work
promotes queued invocations in accepted FIFO order one acknowledgement at a time
bounds retained queues across the whole manager instead of multiplying the limit by aliases
replace supersedes the active and queued work only after the replacement input validates
enforces the attempt ceiling after accepted queued identity while invalid/rejected work is free
reserves pending and terminal generations for every accepted queued invocation
exposes only declared public failures and publishes the closed failed lifecycle
redacts undeclared errors, thrown/rejected adapters, and malformed envelopes
keeps policy denial technical and reports the exact frozen core diagnostic
validates output before exposure and never leaks attacker-controlled output member names
detaches and recursively freezes successful output before publishing it
contains aggregate declared-failure and success expansion at the retained lifecycle boundary
rejects hostile settlement accessors as adapter failure without invoking them repeatedly
makes settlement leases opaque, manager-bound, and one-shot
caps underlying host transports while preserving independent alias pending lifecycles
returns busy for operation reentry while a host callback is being launched
lets reentrant disposal revoke accepted work and prevents late hostile settlement reads
disposes active and queued invocations, invalidates leases, and remains idempotent
returns controlled outcomes for forged handles and cannot expose a partial authority

rejects stale or tampered operation evidence

detects queue ordering and acknowledgement-seam drift

detects public export, TSDoc, and platform drift
detects focused-test and compiler-negative inventory drift
